meta.title: 英中故事｜點選練單字片語
meta.goal: 大量單字／片語，一句英一句中

lines.en: It was 2 a.m., and the ticket was still open.
lines.zh: 凌晨兩點，那張單還開著。

lines.en: The server had been quiet since midnight.
lines.zh: 伺服器從午夜起就一直很安靜。

lines.en: Then one line appeared on the screen: “I can hear you typing.”
lines.zh: 接著螢幕跳出一行字：「我聽得到你在打字。」

lines.en: He froze, fingers above the keyboard.
lines.zh: 他整個人僵住，手指停在鍵盤上方。

lines.en: Nobody else was supposed to be on the system.
lines.zh: 按理說，不該還有別人在這套系統裡。

lines.en: He typed back: “Who is this?”
lines.zh: 他回打：「你是誰？」

lines.en: The reply came in one second: “Your fix from yesterday. It never left.”
lines.zh: 一秒後回覆來了：「你昨天的那個修正。它一直沒離開。」

lines.en: He checked the logs. The deployment was marked complete.
lines.zh: 他查了 log。部署狀態顯示已完成。

lines.en: Still, the ticket remained with him for further investigation.
lines.zh: 可是這張單還停在他手上，要再查。

lines.en: On his side, the error was unable to complete the request.
lines.zh: 在他這邊，錯誤顯示無法完成請求。

lines.en: He sent an update: still work in progress.
lines.zh: 他發了進度：還在處理中。

lines.en: Until further notice, nobody else should touch the test server.
lines.zh: 在另行通知前，別人都不該動測站。

vocab.hint: The reply came in one second.

phrases.en: on my side / on his side

lines.en: Hi Alan,
lines.zh: Alan 你好，

lines.en: Got it.
lines.zh: 收到。

lines.en: I can see the customer is already ACTIVE.
lines.zh: 我可以看到客戶狀態已經是 ACTIVE。

lines.en: But SAP does not have a partner profile for this store.
lines.zh: 但 SAP 沒有這家店的 partner profile。

lines.en: Could you share the exact issue details, replication steps, and test data?
lines.zh: 可以提供精確問題細節、重現步驟和測試資料嗎？

lines.en: Can you check whether the issue reproduces on your side as well?
lines.zh: 可以確認這個問題在你那邊是否也能重現嗎？

lines.en: Until this is fixed, please use the old store’s sold-to for now.
lines.zh: 修好前，請先暫時用舊店的 sold-to。

lines.en: Please let me know once the partner profile has been created.
lines.zh: partner profile 建好後請告訴我。

lines.en: Update on IM-2041: still Work In Progress with Pavani.
lines.zh: IM-2041 進度：還在 Pavani 處理中。

lines.en: It was acknowledged the same night.
lines.zh: 當天晚上就已確認收到。

lines.en: We deployed the fix to the test server yesterday and are waiting for confirmation.
lines.zh: 我們昨天已把修正部到測站，目前在等確認。

lines.en: Thank you
lines.zh: 謝謝

phrases.hint: 比 I saw 更自然

phrases.en: Until this is fixed… for now

lines.en: The train doors closed before she could step in.
lines.zh: 她還沒踏進去，車門就關上了。

lines.en: Rain had been falling since early evening.
lines.zh: 雨從傍晚起就不停地下。

lines.en: She checked her phone for the next arrival.
lines.zh: 她看手機查下一班到站時間。

lines.en: A message popped up from an unknown number.
lines.zh: 一則來自未知號碼的訊息跳出來。

lines.en: “Don’t take the next train.”
lines.zh: 「別搭下一班車。」

lines.en: She looked around the empty platform.
lines.zh: 她環顧空蕩蕩的月台。

lines.en: Nobody else seemed to notice her.
lines.zh: 似乎沒有人注意到她。

lines.en: For now, she decided to stay put.
lines.zh: 她決定先暫時留在原地。

lines.en: Until she knew more, moving felt unsafe.
lines.zh: 在搞清楚之前，移動感覺不安全。

lines.en: Then the lights flickered once.
lines.zh: 接著燈閃了一下。

lines.en: Her phone buzzed again: “Good. Wait for my update.”
lines.zh: 手機又震動：「很好。等我的最新消息。」

lines.en: She let out a breath and replied, “Got it.”
lines.zh: 她吐了一口氣回：「收到。」
